name: Konna Koto mo Aru Kamo ne?
original_name: こんなコトもあるかもね？
source:
“I'm waiting at the beach at 17:00 tomorrow”. 
Such message suddenly arrives to main character. What actions will he take?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“我明天下午5点在海边等你。”
这样的消息突然传到了主人公手中。他会采取什么行动？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
